translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
jab Allah ki madad aur fatah aajaye
aur tum logon  ko dekh lo kay woh foaj darr foaj Allah kay deen mein dakhil horahey hain ,
to apney perwerdigar ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh kero , aur uss say maghfirat maango .   yaqeen jano woh boht moaaf kernay wala hai .
